### STAR Settings

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--star_genome_sa_index_nbases`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Length (bases) of the SA pre-indexing string. Typically between 10 and 15.
Longer strings will use much more memory, but allow faster searches. For small
genomes, the parameter {genomeSAindexNbases must be scaled down to
min(14, log2(GenomeLength)/2 - 1).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `14`
:::
::::
:::::

### BD Rhapsody Settings

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bdrhap_mitochondrial_contigs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Names of the Mitochondrial contigs in the provided Reference Genome. Fragments originating from contigs other than these are
identified as 'nuclear fragments' in the ATACseq analysis pipeline.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"chrM"`, `"chrMT"`, `"M"`, `"MT"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bdrhap_filtering_off`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
By default the input Transcript Annotation files are filtered based on the gene_type/gene_biotype attribute. Only features
having the following attribute values are kept:

  - protein_coding
  - lncRNA
  - IG_LV_gene
  - IG_V_gene
  - IG_V_pseudogene
  - IG_D_gene
  - IG_J_gene
  - IG_J_pseudogene
  - IG_C_gene
  - IG_C_pseudogene
  - TR_V_gene
  - TR_V_pseudogene
  - TR_D_gene
  - TR_J_gene
  - TR_J_pseudogene
  - TR_C_gene

  If you have already pre-filtered the input Annotation files and/or wish to turn-off the filtering, please set this option to True.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bdrhap_wta_only_index`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Build a WTA only index, otherwise builds a WTA + ATAC index.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bdrhap_extra_star_params`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Additional parameters to pass to STAR when building the genome index. Specify exactly like how you would on the command line.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"--limitGenomeGenerateRAM 48000 --genomeSAindexNbases 11"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Cellranger ARC options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--motifs_file`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path to file containing transcription factor motifs in JASPAR format.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"motifs.txt"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--non_nuclear_contigs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name(s) of contig(s) that do not have any chromatin structure, for example,
mitochondria or plastids. These contigs are excluded from peak calling since
the entire contig will be "open" due to a lack of chromatin structure.
Leave empty if there are no such contigs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/make_reference/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/workflows/ingestion/make_reference);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/ingestion/make_reference/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
